ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; the surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels with a ratio heavily weighted towards the <20% intensity range, punctuated by localized high-intensity (white/beige) pixel clusters on tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-grey mapping across ~95% of the visible surface. High-contrast geometric clusters (beige/white) are located at the lateral terminal tips. Sparse, stochastic distribution of small white focal spots (speckles) across the lower-medial quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 45-50 degrees; deep vertical depression relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire margin. Notable macro-indentation (valley) on the medial-trailing edge of the right lobe. The left lobe exhibits more jagged, angular peaks compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer edges, tapering to rounded-point terminations at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of high-intensity pixels on the far left and far right tips, consistent with sessile organism colonization. Scattered, isolated white circular points visible on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions near the central peduncle junction; no deep or high-contrast horizontal rake marks are visible.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biological encrustations on the distal tips of both lobes; multiple small circular depigmented points (likely barnacle scars) on the mid-surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, large irregular notch located on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
